name: Curse
description: Attuning to (or otherwise bonding with) this item inflicts an ongoing curse, which lingers even after the item is removed.

mechanics.text: The curse's own specific drawback lives in this record's own featureParams.curseText — it varies too much item to item (forced vulnerability, disadvantage on attacks/saves, forced behavior, and more) to fully structure, but always ends only via remove curse or similar magic, never by simply removing the item.
